description: Reference library of tracks by Kainer and Il Diablo. Pocket Producer uses this as the source of truth for style, arrangement feedback, and prompt generation. Edit freely — this file is read at startup and on every list_reference_tracks call.

producers.name: Kainer
producers.bio: UK-based producer. Melodic, machine-music leaning techno with hardware-driven grooves, hypnotic repetition, and restrained harmony.

mix_fingerprint: low-end sits wide and warm, slight saturation on the sub
kick at -6 to -7 dBFS peak, punchy but not clipping
reverb is sparse — short plates on percussion, long halls reserved for breaks
sidechain is felt, not heard — 2-3 dB of ducking on pads, not pumping
stereo image widens above 300 Hz, everything below kept mono
arrangement_patterns: 8-bar intro on drums + atmosphere, no bass
first drop around bar 32, bassline enters, one melodic element
breakdown at bar 96 with a single riser and filtered lead
second drop adds the counter-melody, peak density around bar 160
outro mirrors the intro — strip back to atmosphere

producers.name: Il Diablo
producers.bio: Rolling, peak-time tech-house and tribal techno. Drum-forward, heavy on groove, unafraid of a vocal hook.

mix_fingerprint: groove-first — the percussion bus is the loudest non-kick element
kick and bass share the low end via side-chain, not EQ carving
vocals compressed hard and placed just above the pad bed
short room reverb glues percussion together
master bus: gentle glue compressor, 1-2 dB of reduction
arrangement_patterns: bassline drops at bar 17, vocal hook teased
full drop by bar 33 — percussion, bass, vocal, hook
stripped breakdown at bar 97 — percussion and vocal only
second drop is harder, adds the acid lead
outro mirrors intro — 16 bars of drums only

mix_critique_checklist: Kick and bass not fighting (sidechain or EQ carve)?
Vocals sitting above the pad bed, not buried?
Stereo width reserved for highs, sub kept centered?
Reverb tails not swallowing the groove?
Master bus headroom: peak near -1 dBTP, integrated LUFS -8 to -10 for club / -14 for streaming?
Reference A/B done against at least two commercial tracks in the same genre?
Mono compatibility check — does it still groove in mono?
Transient clarity on the kick and top percussion?
Any frequency masking in the 200-500 Hz mud zone?
